name: kyberna DataCenter Balzers
notes: Kyberna's Balzers data center was publicly reported as officially opened in April 2011; current third-party listings place kyberna DataCenter at Fabrikstrasse 4, 9496 Balzers. Capacity not disclosed.

name: Acronis Liechtenstein Cloud Data Center
notes: Liechtenstein Marketing reported that Acronis opened a new data center in Eschen, providing a local cloud location for MSPs and customer data sovereignty. Capacity not disclosed; described as a micro data center.

name: Liechtenstein State Administration Rechencenter Eschen
notes: Official government release says the government visited the LLV Rechencenter in Eschen; the facility has redundant power, redundant cooling and aerosol fire suppression. Capacity not disclosed.

name: LKW Kollokation TZ Eschen
notes: Rheintal IX lists a live physical location at Telefonzentrale Eschen, Liechtensteinische Kraftwerke, Hub 37; ColoMap and Euro-IX identify it as LKW Kollokation TZ Eschen / Rheintal IX POP. Capacity not disclosed.

name: SupraNet Eschen Data Center
notes: SupraNet's official site says the SupraNet group operates modern data centers in Schaan and Eschen and offers housing products through two data centers. Third-party listing places the Eschen site at Wirtschaftspark 65. Capacity not disclosed.

name: rechenzentrum.li / Alpensoft ONLINE Mauren
notes: Weak historical lead only: rechenzentrum.li lists Schellenbergerstr. 39, 9493 Mauren, but its current page says the website is disabled; a business directory describes Alpensoft ONLINE at the same address with hosting, server housing and Rechenzentrum keywords. Operational status and facility scale unverified.

name: Speedcom Ruggell Data Center
notes: Speedcom official materials state it operates two data centers in Schaan and Ruggell, with georedundancy, ISO 27001:2022 certification, server hosting, server housing and cloud services. Address listings place the Ruggell site at Industriering 14. Capacity not disclosed.

name: Speedcom Schaan Data Center
notes: Speedcom official materials state it operates two data centers in Schaan and Ruggell. The Schaan address is Im alten Riet 153 / 4.OG; third-party data-center listings also identify a Schaan facility at Im alten Riet 153, historically shown as Newsnet/Speedcom. Capacity not disclosed.

name: SupraNet Schaan Data Center
notes: SupraNet's official site says it operates high-security data centers in Schaan and Eschen and lists its Schaan address at Im alten Riet 121. Datacenters.com lists SupraNet Schaan as a colocation facility with ISO 27001 certification. Capacity not disclosed.
